# Bitfroest.fs 0.0.52

Changes since version [0.0.51](https://github.com/s-a/Bitfroest.fs/releases/tag/v0.0.51).

## Updating

In the VS Code Extensions view, update Bitfroest.fs on the pre-release channel. If the stable channel is selected, choose **Install Pre-Release Version**. This release requires VS Code 1.100.0 or later within the supported version range.

## Added

- An experimental Apple Silicon (ARM64) package is available on the pre-release channel. Use disposable files for testing. Include the macOS, VS Code, and extension versions and steps to reproduce when reporting a problem. [Report a bug](https://github.com/s-a/Bitfroest.fs/issues/new?template=bug-report.yml)
- On Windows, click the address bar icon to find drive roots at the bottom of the location menu. The system drive comes first, followed by other drives, including mapped network drives. Up to ten recently visited UNC share roots appear below a divider.
- File operation errors can open a prefilled GitHub issue for review. Recognized URLs are masked. Paths may retain up to three trailing components, so review the report before submitting it.

## Improved

- File manager dialogs, file search and the shortcut recorder use compact, theme-aware headers. File operations show the selection count beside the title when known.
- Copy and move confirmations align Source and Target. New Folder and New Text File show the destination folder. Path fields shorten long paths in the middle when space is limited and show the full path in the tooltip. Select an underlined path to edit its full value.
- Click outside a modal dialog to dismiss it. A running search closes after cancellation completes.
- The README gallery focuses on common file operations. It shows how to prepare a project handover, organize handover notes, and remove temporary files.

## Fixed

- Selected text stays highlighted when the text menu opens with a right-click in the file manager or configuration, including while renaming a file. The menu supports cut, copy, paste and select all where the field permits those actions.
- Background updates to the file panes preserve the text and selection in the active address editor.
- Ctrl-clicking an address bar breadcrumb opens the resolved folder in a new tab, including when the breadcrumb points to a symbolic link.
- If the filesystem refuses a deletion, the file manager identifies the affected entry and reports how many entries were already deleted. On Windows and Linux, the lock inspector is available when the operation can offer it.

## Known limitations

- CI checks the Apple Silicon build and package. The system file clipboard, native context menu, opening files in their associated applications, and the Trash view are unavailable on macOS. Intel Macs are outside the preview.
